      "assumption_impact": "medium"
    },

      "epistemic_status": "reported",
      "confidence": 1.0,

      "assumption": null,
      "assumption_impact": null
    },
    {
      "text": "The transaction is expected to close after the separation of Discovery Global in Q3 2026.",
      "claim_type": "predictive_claim",
      "epistemic_status": "reported",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "evidence_quote": "The transaction is expected to close after the previously announced separation of WBD’s Global Networks division, Discovery Global, into a new publicly-traded company, which is now expected to be completed in Q3 2026.",
      "assumption": "The separation of Discovery Global will occur as scheduled.",
      "assumption_impact": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "Each WBD shareholder will receive $23.25 in cash and $4.501 in Netflix shares per WBD share.",
      "claim_type": "factual_claim",
      "epistemic_status": "reported",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "evidence_quote": "Under the terms of the agreement, each WBD shareholder will receive $23.25 in cash and $4.501 in shares of Netflix common stock for each share of WBD common stock outstanding at the closing of the transaction.",
      "assumption": null,
      "assumption_impact": null
    },
    {
      "text": "The stock component is subject to a collar based on Netflix’s stock price.",
      "claim_type": "factual_claim",
      "epistemic_status": "reported",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "evidence_quote": "The stock component is subject to a collar under which WBD shareholders will receive Netflix stock valued at $4.50 per share, provided the 15-day volume weighted average price (“VWAP”) of Netflix stock price (measured three trading days prior to closing) falls between $97.91 and $119.67.",
      "assumption": null,
      "assumption_impact": null
    },
    {
      "text": "The transaction was unanimously approved by the Boards of Directors of Netflix and WBD.",
      "claim_type": "factual_claim",
      "epistemic_status": "reported",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "evidence_quote": "The transaction was unanimously approved by the Boards of Directors of both Netflix and WBD.",
      "assumption": null,
      "assumption_impact": null
    },
    {
      "text": "Completion of the transaction is subject to regulatory approvals, WBD shareholder approval, and other customary closing conditions.",
      "claim_type": "factual_claim",
      "epistemic_status": "reported",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "evidence_quote": "In addition to the completion of the separation of Discovery Global (WBD’s Global Networks business), completion of the transaction is subject to required regulatory approvals, approval of WBD shareholders and other customary closing conditions.",
      "assumption": null,
      "assumption_impact": null
    },
    {
      "text": "The transaction is expected to close in 12-18 months.",
      "claim_type": "predictive_claim",
      "epistemic_status": "reported",
      "confidence": 0.8,
      "evidence_quote": "The transaction is expected to close in 12-18 months.",
      "assumption": "No unforeseen delays will occur.",
      "assumption_impact": "medium"
    }
  ]
}
